svg.title: Spot Clicker full circuit, revision B
svg.text: Built from manufacturer data, 10 Nov 2026 · same topology as PRODUCT_CIRCUIT rev A · not yet built or measured
No capacitors added (no 104). The battery plugs into the TinyCircuits ASL1201 adapter: never cut, solder or modify the pack.
C = common (find it with the meter)
VBUSDETECT flags any USB 5 V (even a wall charger)
P0.31 reads VBAT via 1 MΩ / 510 kΩ · keep P0.14 LOW
P0.13 as input → charge ≈50 mA (LOW → ≈100 mA)
normally open, MX-style stem · internal pull-up
R1, R2, Q1, CR1 and the GND hub
flat face toward you, legs down: E B C
GND hub: every return meets here
battery −: one wire from the J1 GND hole to the GND hub

g.text: Charging
Slide S1 ON, then plug in USB-C.
≈50 mA (TI limits for 2.7 kΩ: 47.8–53.7 mA).
The XIAO cannot sense battery temperature:
charge at room temperature, while watching.
Unplug if the pack gets warm, swells or smells.
When USB is plugged in
S1 OFF isolates the battery, but USB still
energizes BAT_SW through the charger.
Portable firmware keeps D4 LOW whenever
VBUSDETECT = 1. Bench builds with a separate
motor supply use an explicit bench flag.
No 104
No capacitor is installed; the XIAO keeps its
own onboard capacitors. Only if the noise test
fails: a 10 nF (103) ceramic across M1, at the
motor. Motor-maker range: 100 pF–100 nF.
Twist the motor leads; keep them short.
Battery limits
Total current target: under 120 mA
(pack maximum 150 mA).
Proposed firmware: no buzz below 3.3 V,
sleep below 3.0 V (pack cut-off 2.75 V;
its protection acts only at 2.4 V).

svg.text: Electrical schematic, not to scale. Sources, calculations and the build/test order: docs/FULL_CIRCUIT.md.
